key_insight: GLOBE turns product-listing optimization into a continual learning loop by storing successful rewriting strategies as explicit, field-scoped agentic memory rather than keeping them hidden in prompts.
engineering_relevance: For e-commerce generative search, this offers a more interpretable and reusable way to improve listings across categories while reducing harmful or unstable edits.
method: Editor applies field-specific behaviors to rewrite product listings.
Reflector converts rank-based feedback into behavior updates.
Moderator filters redundant proposals, Curator commits accepted changes, and harmful behaviors are deactivated.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, and that feedback-driven evolution plus moderation improves effectiveness and reduces downside risk, including on unseen product categories.
watch_item: Because the system depends on feedback quality and careful moderation, noisy rankings or over-aggressive deactivation could limit learning or slow adaptation.
paper_title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
